name: Kyle Brazeal
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Kyle Brazeal is a West Hollywood resident with a background in private-sector finance and operations. He entered the race after participating in meetings about the Fountain Avenue bike lane project, calling for a more accountable City Hall.

sentences.text: Kyle Brazeal is a West Hollywood resident with a background in private-sector finance and operations.
He entered the race after participating in meetings about the Fountain Avenue bike lane project, calling for a more accountable City Hall.

items.text: Brazeal opposes the Fountain Avenue redesign as proposed. He supports extending ADA-compliant sidewalks there. He wants public input and privacy safeguards before renewing the Flock Safety camera contract. He backs a pilot childcare subsidy for families who do not qualify for existing assistance. He supports protecting rent-stabilized housing, along with traffic-calming measures and a speed-camera pilot.
